name: Ludim
overview: The Ludim are identified in Scripture as descendants of Mizraim, highlighting their place within the genealogical framework of the nations (Genesis 10:13). They are associated with warrior attributes, notably skilled in archery, as indicated by references to Lud as those who 'draw the bow' (Isaiah 66:19) and their role among the men of war alongside Persia and Phut (Ezekiel 27:10). This martial character is further emphasized in prophetic contexts where related peoples are described as mighty men and skilled with shields and bows (Jeremiah 46:9), underscoring their significance as a distinct, formidable group in biblical history.
